mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_message (from_user_id, from_nickname, from_avatar, to_user_id, content, is_read, create_time) VALUES (#{fromUserId}, #{fromNickname}, #{fromAvatar}, #{toUserId}, #{content}, 0, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, from_user_id, from_nickname, from_avatar, to_user_id, content, is_read, create_time FROM user_message WHERE to_user_id = #{toUserId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

mapper.update: UPDATE user_message SET is_read = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND to_user_id = #{toUserId}
